bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
n=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
target="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed"
sha=9f39ceacf6604eaf1777b83c429770c2296a7c68
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || exit 61
git fetch --no-tags origin "$sha" >/dev/null 2>&1
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 62
mkdir -p "$root/.worktrees"
worktree="$root/.worktrees/stk-separate-9f39cea"
if test -e "$worktree"; then test "$(git -C "$worktree" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 63; else git worktree add --detach "$worktree" "$sha" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
test -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" || exit 64
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$n" 2>/dev/null)" = true || exit 65
test "$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ec 'createvdobot|create-videobot|videobot-poll' || true)" -eq 1 || exit 66
base=create-videobot:menu-home-e9cc45d
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$n")" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$base")" || exit 67
img=create-videobot:sticker-separated-9f39cea
docker build --pull=false --network none -t "$img" -f - "$worktree" >/dev/null <<'DOCKERFILE'
FROM create-videobot:menu-home-e9cc45d
COPY --chown=node:node src/telegram/menuPanel.mjs /opt/videobot/src/telegram/menuPanel.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node src/telegram/stickerWizard.mjs /opt/videobot/src/telegram/stickerWizard.mjs
DOCKERFILE
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint node "$img" --check /opt/videobot/src/telegram/menuPanel.mjs >/dev/null
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint node "$img" --check /opt/videobot/src/telegram/stickerWizard.mjs >/dev/null
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint sh "$img" -c '! grep -q "menu:stickers" /opt/videobot/src/telegram/menuPanel.mjs' || exit 68
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint grep "$img" -q "screen:'sticker_choose',stickerDraft:null,waiting:null" /opt/videobot/src/telegram/stickerWizard.mjs || exit 69
token="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$n")"
dbpass="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_db_password"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$n")"
test -f "$token" && test -f "$dbpass" || exit 70
pg=deploy-postgres-1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$pg")" = true || exit 71
user="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'printf %s "$POSTGRES_USER"')"
net="$(docker inspect -f '{{range $k,$v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{println $k}}{{end}}' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d')"
pin="$HOME/.local/state/create-videobot/sticker-pin"
test -f "$pin/group2373696859_thread4640.json" || exit 72
export VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE="$token" VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE="$dbpass" VIDEOBOT_STICKER_PIN_STATE_SOURCE="$pin" GSERVER_POSTGRES_USER="$user" GSERVER_POSTGRES_NETWORK="$net"
compose="$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml"
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$compose" config --quiet || exit 73
armed=0
rollback(){ docker image tag create-videobot:menu-separate-before create-videobot:local-poll || true; docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$compose" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo SEPARATION_ROLLBACK_ATTEMPTED; }
trap 'if test "$armed" = 1; then rollback; fi' EXIT
docker image tag create-videobot:local-poll create-videobot:menu-separate-before
armed=1
docker image tag "$img" create-videobot:local-poll
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$compose" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null || exit 74
sleep 8
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$n")" = true || exit 75
docker exec "$n" sh -c '! grep -q "menu:stickers" /opt/videobot/src/telegram/menuPanel.mjs' || exit 76
docker exec "$n" grep -q "screen:'sticker_choose',stickerDraft:null,waiting:null" /opt/videobot/src/telegram/stickerWizard.mjs || exit 77
docker logs --tail 900 "$n" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$' || exit 78
docker logs --tail 900 "$n" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_GATE_PUBLIC_RELEASE=CONNECTED$' || exit 79
test "$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ec 'createvdobot|create-videobot|videobot-poll' || true)" -eq 1 || exit 80
armed=0
echo CREATEVDOBOT_STICKER_VIDEO_MENU_SEPARATED_RUNTIME=PASS
echo DEPLOYED_SOURCE_SHA="$sha"
